description: Create or update the project's saved brand: business information, colors, fonts, logos, personas, overviews, and brand-context file tags. May import from a public website URL; replacement can delete prior brand data and import assets/references. Does not restyle or publish a site: use apply_brand_kit_to_site separately. Starts an asynchronous internal-agent operation; poll get_agent_session and answer any replacement confirmation before it proceeds.

instructions.description: Requested changes for this operation only. Include necessary references, not conversation history, credentials, or unrelated personal data.

sessionId.description: Omit to start this operation. To continue, supply the returned sessionId with the same operation and target; mismatches and legacy sessions are rejected.

name: create_or_update_brand_kit
